$schema.description:
!IMPORTANT DO NOT TOUCH
Config schema format path

configVersion.description:
!IMPORTANT DO NOT TOUCH
Config format version number

token.description: The Discord bot token used to authenticate

embeds.description: Configuration options for embeds. Note that embeds aren't normally used in this project but the colors are used still

discord.description: Configuration options for discord related stuff

saveToFiles.description: Whether log output should be written to files

location.description: The location of where these files should be saved

errorLogChannel.description: A discord channel id where error logs will be sent. Not providing one disables logging to a channel

backupConfigs.description: Whether backup copies of config files should be created

other.description: Configuration options for misc/other stuff or things that don't have a good location
